newsitem.title: UGANDA: Museveni blames rebels for Uganda grenade attacks.
newsitem.headline: Museveni blames rebels for Uganda grenade attacks.

text.p: President Yoweri Museveni blamed grenade attacks which killed nine people in Kampala last week on a rebel group which recently launched raids on western Uganda from the neighbouring Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Addressing a public meeting in Fort Portal, western Uganda, on Saturday, Museveni also accused the Sudan government of aiding the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) rebels, witnesses said.
He said the three grenade attacks in Kampala suburbs were carried out by remnants of the ADF group which earlier had been repulsed by the Uganda army on the Congo border.
Local officials in Kampala had earlier said the grenade attacks were apparently the work of ordinary criminals.

Officials in Kampala said on Sunday the police had been placed on alert to guard against further attacks. They said last week's attacks appeared to be directed partly against the police and local defence groups.
